Tall portrait beside an oversized heading and numbered entries.
Oversized part number and lower headline, compact right-angle photographic collage.
Central evidence area with concise prose and two warm photographic details; chart only appropriate with real data.
Same chapter language; requires a distinct second-chapter composition under current user rules.
Large interior image paired with grouped explanatory text, generous title separation.
Edge-to-edge panoramic photo, centered title, captions and smaller editorial photographs.
Heavy closing typography, black-and-white photos and baseline. No source brand copy may leak.

limitations: Only raster reference photos exist locally; no claim to original high-resolution media.

visualAcceptance.scope: curated-001 final candidate, exact hashed 30-page fixture and LibreOffice-rendered export; not all possible future input or other templates
limitations: Microsoft PowerPoint and WPS were not tested. Acceptance is for inspected LibreOffice-rendered output produced with soffice.
Layout pool and fixed-font capacities are finite; arbitrary longer titles/body or exhausted unique compositions must warn and need additional authored layouts.
Stress copy was validated through planner/render/source-coverage paths, not separately LibreOffice-rendered.
Reference photos originate in finite-resolution supplied rasters; this is not a high-resolution asset replacement.
This report accepts the exact curated-001 fixture/export only, not all templates or all future decks.
